content: Instead of considering sub-word features, this paper proposes a novel approach to mitigate the impact of ASR errors. We consider reference transcriptions and ASR hypotheses as two domains, and adapt the source domain data (reference transcriptions) to the target domain data (ASR hypotheses) by projecting these two domains in the shared common space. Therefore, it can effectively benefit the SQA model by improving the robustness to ASR errors in the SQA model.
